race.comment: MISHANI EXTREME (8) started at $4.60 last time but could only manage eighth, beaten 2 lengths, at Ipswich over 1100m. Rock-hard fit for this and draws favourably in gate three. Backmarker who keeps coming and his best form puts him right in this contest. CRYPTO MISS (11) showed good early dash and raced on the speed last start before fading to finish 1.3 lengths back in fourth over 1000m at Eagle Farm. Will be handy in the run and should give backers a sight. The well-related JACKA STANDS ALONE (6) (half to 2xG3 winner and G2 placed Raiment) just missed the frame when fourth last start over 1210m at this track. Has a very good record here including two wins from four starts and shapes as one of the leading contenders. BLANTONS RUN (3) returns from a layoff of four months. Scored over 1000m at this circuit to launch the last campaign. Boasts a first-up record of two wins and two placings from seven attempts and rates a definite top-three chance while fresh.
